        bb = sandbox.add_beam(x=x, y=by, width=seg_len, height=0.2, angle=angle, density=10.0)

        bot_chord.append(bb)

            sandbox.add_joint(bot_chord[i - 1], bb, (WALL_X + i * seg_len, by), type='rigid')
